==Description==
'''TDS Experimental''' is a game made by Paradoxum Games. It is used by the developers to make public tests, mostly for backend changes, which later get moved to the main game.

It is currently not playable, as it has been privated.

==Notable Differences==
'''TDS Experimental''' has multiple differences with Tower Defense Simulator other than what the developers are currently testing, with some even being removed at a later point.
*As part of the most recent two tests, every player was given {{Gem|1,000,000}} and {{Coins|10,000,000}}. Additionally, if the player was below {{Level|100}}, they would become {{Level|100}}.
*The screen is covered in a large wall of text, which shows the user's username and ID.
**A single line of this is not actually aligned with the rest of the text.
*The version listed in the bottom right corner is different.
*'''TDS Experimental''' does not support private servers.
*The lobby's server size is 50 instead of 30, while match server size is 25 instead of 6.

===Former Differences===
*When it was first made playable by everyone, multiple debug tools and statistic editors were not removed from the game and could instead be opened by pressing F3.
*While {{ReviveTicket|Revive Tickets}} were disabled in Tower Defense Simulator, they could be used in '''TDS Experimental'''.
*In the fourth test, the statistics of [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Ace Pilot]] were different than the ones in Tower Defense Simulator.
**Altered versions of these statistics would later be added to Tower Defense Simulator.
*Legacy survival modes were enabled in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in the sixth test, though these were quickly removed.

==Test History==
*'''20 August 2024'''
**An optimization test is started by Nexure.
*'''30 September 2024'''
**A test for backend changes is started by Nexure, with the goal being teleporting between places.
*'''3 October 2024'''
**A test for backend changes is started by Nexure, with the goal being teleporting between places.
*'''11 October 2024'''
**A test for backend changes is started by Nexure, with the goal being teleporting between places.
*'''19 October 2024'''
**A test for backend changes is started by Nexure. Players are given {{Coins|10,000,000}}, {{Gem|1,000,000}} and if they were not already, {{Level|100}}, with the goal of playing for a longer amount of time than other tests.
*'''24 January 2025'''
**A test for invisible behind the scenes changes meant to stop the game from breaking is started by Nexure. Players are given {{Coins|10,000,000}}, {{Gem|1,000,000}} and if they were not already, {{Level|100}}, with the goal of breaking the game as much as possible.
